verdict.rationale: Entra documents Conditional Access as its auth-policy engine, and it explicitly references device-based Conditional Access policies built on device identities, so device trust can be checked before an app session is granted. The pack never shows which posture signals are evaluated (managed, encrypted, screen-locked). It ties device management to the separate Intune family rather than to Entra itself. Missing for 10: documented posture checks for encryption and screen lock, details of a device-compliance or managed-device grant control, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, only healthy devices get in — device posture (managed, encrypted, screen-locked) is checked in the auth policy before an app session is granted

citations.quote: Device identities are a prerequisite for scenarios like device-based Conditional Access policies and Mobile Device Management with the Microsoft Intune family of products.
Secure the application – Manage configuration of permissions, multifactor authentication, Conditional Access, tokens, and certificates.
